name: SEIS OpenAI-curated build workbench
policy: Use openai-curated, openai-bundled, and openai-primary-runtime plugins first for core SEIS build work.

sprint_1.goal: Turn SEIS from a repository hub into a usable closed-code operating cockpit.

modules.deliverable: Browser-first SEIS cockpit with repo, plugin, workspace, security, and build status panels.
first_actions: Create a Vite or Next.js shell under apps/web.
Add operational navigation for Repository, Plugins, Workspace, Data, Security, and Build lanes.
Render plugin registry and policy data from data/*.json.

modules.deliverable: Backend decision record and first state model for plugin registry, repo visibility, and workspace links.
first_actions: Use Convex-first for reactive cockpit state unless SQL/reporting becomes dominant.
Keep Supabase or Neon as Postgres lane for durable analytics and reporting.
Document environment variables before deployment work.

modules.deliverable: Expo mobile shell for SEIS status, build review, and plugin health.
first_actions: Choose Expo template and navigation style.
Reuse cockpit data contracts from packages/core.
Add Android smoke test path before release decisions.

modules.deliverable: SwiftUI desktop inspector for local SEIS repo, plugin cache, zip audits, and branch sync.
first_actions: Define a small SwiftUI app shell.
Expose read-only status commands first.
Keep destructive repo actions behind verification gates.

modules.deliverable: Workspace operating layer for docs, backlog, calendar, mail, and team updates.
first_actions: Keep Drive and Calendar IDs mirrored in integrations/google-workspace.json.
Use the Google Sheet backlog as planning input.
Write every external workspace outcome back into SEIS docs or data.

modules.deliverable: Research notebook lane for model, citation, dataset, and technical reference decisions.
first_actions: Create source-backed decision notes before importing research into product code.
Keep citations and dataset links separate from implementation claims.
Use Deepnote or data notebooks only when executable analysis is needed.

modules.deliverable: Security and quality gate before source repo deletion, deployment, or automation expansion.
first_actions: Add threat model for SEIS repo consolidation and plugin routing.
Run code review/security workflows before deploy work.
Keep Sentry/Datadog setup separate until app runtime exists.

rule: Build from the OpenAI-curated route first, keep outputs in SEIS, and keep main mirrored with UIXAppTTR.
